title.zh: 对称与旋转 · 对折与转圈

desc.zh: 沿一条线对折、两边严丝合缝，那条线就是对称轴；转过一个角度又变回自己，那是旋转对称。正方形有 4 条轴，平行四边形一条都没有、却转半圈就重合——最后开一台万花筒，只画一小块，图案自己长满。
desc.en: Fold along a line and the two halves match exactly — that line is an axis of symmetry; turn through the right angle and the shape is itself again — rotational symmetry. A square has 4 axes; a parallelogram has none, yet matches itself after half a turn. At the end, a kaleidoscope grows a full pattern from one small wedge you draw.
